XenotypeDef.label: phoenix lord
XenotypeDef.description: Forged in the heart of a volcano, phoenix lords are entirely impervious to heat, can spew fire from their hands or burst into a large ball of flame. They age extremely rapidly and will resurrect as a baby when killed. They must constantly burn chemfuel to fuel their phoenix flames, which makes them smell like gas. They will also burn any worn armor that isn't extremely heat resistant. They can be rarely found in extremely hot environments such as deserts or near volcanoes. Due to their similarity to impids, phoenix lords will allow impids in their ranks to boost their numbers.
